test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If tan40⁰ = alpha , then find (tan320⁰ - tan 310⁰)/(1 + tan320⁰.tan 310⁰).
solution:
**Given:**

tan 40° = α 

**Formula used:**

Tan (A - B) = (tan A - tan B)/1 + tan A × tan B

tan (90° - θ) = cot θ 

cot θ × tan θ = 1

**Calculation:**

⇒ (tan320⁰ - tan 310⁰)/(1 + tan320⁰.tan 310⁰) = tan (320° - 310°)

⇒ tan 10° 

Now, we can write:

Tan 10° = tan (50° - 40°)

⇒ [(tan 50° - tan 40°)/1 + (tan 50° × tan 40°)]

⇒ [tan (90° - 40°) - tan 40°/1 + tan (90° - 40°) × tan 40°]

⇒ cot 40° - tan 40°/1 + cot 40° × tan 40°

⇒ (1/α - α)/1 + 1

⇒ (1/α - α)/2

⇒ (1 - α²)/2α 

**∴ The correct answer is (1 - α2)/2α.**
